djs.name: DJ Mack
djs.status_note: Channel inayojitambulisha kama Dj mack Mashine ina video ndefu zilizotafsiriwa. Haki za full movie/dub hazijathibitishwa; hatuunganishi uploads ndefu.

djs.name: Babu DJ
djs.status_note: Mahojiano yanamtaja kama mtafsiri wa filamu. Channel inayoitwa BABU DJ MOVIES ONLINE haijathibitishwa kuwa inaendeshwa naye; haki za tafsiri hazijathibitishwa.
djs.original_note: Prime Video ina listing ya filamu asilia; si dub ya Babu DJ. Listing hii ni ya Amazon Marekani na upatikanaji hutegemea eneo.

djs.name: DJ Prabhat
djs.status_note: Jina DJ Prabhat lina channels tofauti. Hakuna chanzo cha msingi kilichothibitisha kuwa huyu ndiye mtafsiri wa movie za Kiswahili/Tanzania; hatujaunganisha film.

djs.name: Remmy DJ
djs.status_note: SwaMedia inamhusisha na baadhi ya series, lakini listing au malipo si uthibitisho wa leseni ya dub. Link hapa ni kwa original version pekee.
djs.original_note: Netflix ina listing ya original series; haionyeshi dub ya Remmy DJ. Upatikanaji na lugha hutegemea eneo.

djs.name: Murphy DJ
djs.status_note: Channel inayojitambulisha kama DJ Murphy Movie Swahili ina clips fupi. Haki za full translation hazijathibitishwa; tunaonyesha kipande kifupi tu, si season nzima.
djs.original_note: BBC iPlayer ina vipindi vya original Merlin; si tafsiri ya Kiswahili ya DJ Murphy. Upatikanaji hutegemea nchi.

djs.name: DJ Mjukuu
djs.status_note: Channel inayojitambulisha kama Dj mjukuu Og ina vipande/episodes za Kiswahili. Haki za full movie au season ya dub hazijathibitishwa; full uploads hazijaunganishwa.
djs.original_note: Ukurasa huu ni wa filamu asilia na wauzaji rasmi, si tafsiri ya DJ Mjukuu; upatikanaji hutegemea eneo.

djs.name: DJ Bryton
djs.status_note: Baadhi ya catalog pages na captions zinamtaja Bryton, lakini hakuna channel rasmi inayoweza kuthibitishwa wala leseni ya dub. Link hapa ni kwa original version pekee.
djs.original_title: The Brothers Sun · toleo la asili
djs.original_note: Netflix ina original series; si dub ya DJ Bryton. Attribution ya Bryton kwenye catalog nyingine haithibitishi haki; upatikanaji hutegemea eneo.

djs.name: Juma Khan
djs.status_note: Channel inayojitambulisha kama DJ Juma Khan Movies TZ inasema haimiliki filamu asilia. Haki za voice-over/dub hazijathibitishwa; full-dub link haijaunganishwa.
djs.original_note: JioHotstar ina ukurasa wa original Kavach; si tafsiri ya Juma Khan. Upatikanaji hutegemea eneo.

djs.name: DJ Skills
djs.status_note: Mahojiano yanamtaja kama mtafsiri wa movies Tanzania, lakini channel rasmi ya filamu zake na leseni za full works hazijathibitishwa.

djs.name: DJ Six Fingers
djs.status_note: Channel inayojitambulisha kama ya DJ Six Fingers ina uploads ndefu za tafsiri. Haki za dub hazijathibitishwa; full episodes/seasons hazijaunganishwa.
djs.original_note: iQIYI ina listing ya original series; si tafsiri ya DJ Six Fingers. Upatikanaji hutegemea eneo.
